title: Does combining a steering vector with a probe-based monitor catch its own steering failures?

original_idea.body: Set up a closed loop: steer toward refusal, probe steered activations, and on adversarial inputs that defeat steering check whether an independent probe catches the unsafe output better than a shared-direction probe.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: tests whether shared-direction steering+monitoring is real defense-in-depth or false redundancy.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (shared vs independent probe failure-catching).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Safety-harness design on open models, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Joint steering+monitoring exists; shared-direction failure-catching may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Shared-direction redundancy question may be partly open.
